explanation: The recorder performs three whole-process debugger stop/continue cycles per ordinary pen input, plus release observations. Each stop reads target state and writes diagnostic records. The rare background-step recovery prevents an abort but does not remove this recurring overhead.
limitations: Event observation intervals are not exact target execution or pause durations.
These logs do not separately profile native debugger overhead, application work, register/memory reads, stack lookup, or synchronous log output.
Packet timestamp span describes saved native input timestamps, not an independent stopwatch of the physical stroke.
This arithmetic capture does not measure normal CSP pen latency, rendered output, post-correction, or identical pen feel.
next_action: Analyze this complete saved capture offline. No repeat of this baseline is needed to investigate lag. Profile or redesign the recorder before asking the operator for further capture.
